title: HYDRA-EO visualization data catalog
description: Complete distinct dataset inventory imported from the public HYDRA-EO Geospatial Dataset repository, including explicit synthetic, example, duplicate, and unresolved classifications.

datasets.title: Chaparrillo Sentinel-2 surface reflectance subset

provenance.processing_chain: Copied from data/processed/s2_to_rm.tif and losslessly converted to a DEFLATE-compressed Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF with GDAL. RGB uses source bands B4, B3, and B2.
provenance.processing_level: Source repository labels the file processed; exact Sentinel-2 processing level not provided.
provenance.quality: Sentinel-2 SCL is present as source band 11; no quality mask is applied automatically.
provenance.known_limitations: Acquisition date, product identifier, atmospheric-correction method, calibration record, and data license are not provided. No stress or disease inference is made. Sixteen source paths contain byte-identical copies and are represented once.
provenance.contact: Carlos Luis Camino González, Wageningen University & Research

datasets.license: No data license stated in the source repository; public GitHub access only.

datasets.title: Unverified HYDRA CRE scoring table

provenance.processing_chain: One byte-identical copy retained from nine source paths under biochemistry, calibration, genomics, leaf physiology, metabolomics, qPCR, visual scoring, and metadata folders.
provenance.known_limitations: The nine files are identical despite representing different folder roles. Coordinates and field meanings are not supported by a protocol in the repository. Values are shown only as unverified source records and must not be interpreted as measurements, locations, disease diagnoses, or model outputs.
provenance.contact: Carlos Luis Camino González, Wageningen University & Research

datasets.site: Italian alfalfa and Chaparrillo source labels

provenance.processing_chain: Source files preserved as archives; no coordinate transformation or map rendering applied.
provenance.known_limitations: Coordinate values conflict with the declared CRS or expected named location. Rendering would invent a location, so these assets remain catalogued but non-spatial until corrected upstream.
